ValidationRule.description: BOPI-700 Ensures the CPQ opportunities can't be closed/won if the contract start date or URL are missing
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> "Workato", NOT(ISBLANK(sbaa__Opportunity__c)), sbaa__RecordField__c = "sbaa__Opportunity__c", sbaa__Opportunity__r.Pricebook2.Name = "CPQ", sbaa__ApprovalStep__c = 2, OR( ISBLANK(sbaa__Opportunity__r.Contract_Start_Date__c), ISBLANK(sbaa__Opportunity__r.Contract_URL__c) ), ISPICKVAL(sbaa__Status__c, "Approved") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The contract Start Date and URL are required to close the Opportunity.
